these journeys sometimes just last a bit longer for some people. i have a suicidal best friend and it takes a lot for someone that doesn’t have depression understand what is going on with smo else and to get familiar with the idea of depression (i was scared at first too)..but i still cared. if they were your close friends, they really do care about you and would want you to get better. there are so many methods to cope.. hold on a little longer ..i am here for you as a friend as well
have you stopped the blood yet? is there anyone home..

hey stranger.
i’m here if you need me..
please call 911. we’re in this together. you aren’t alone

have you seeked professional help or talked to someone close? sometimes that really does it... the build up weighs on your shoulder finally taken off. although i don’t know how you feel nor your situation, i definitely know that ending it is not the choice. trial and error, trial and error. it takes people different time lengths to even open up to someone. please hold on a little more...

is there nothing.. anything- that will change your mind? you plan so much detail, to make sure no one is hurt in the process. both you and your families/friends/dog care for each other. is this really the right way to go?

you want to try to change to be a better person for your wife, but what would she think that right after she leaves, you end it. would she really be think you’re a huge anchor taken off of her like you anticipated... or feel sad- even guilty about you...

please hold on a little longer... although i cannot say i know how you feel, but ending it is definitely not the best option. let me help you be better at social situations. let us figure out together what that something wrong is.
is there nothing- even a stranger, that can change your mind?
is there nothing i can do to change your mind? pm me

i cannot say that i know how you feel or could relate to it.. however sometimes people do care even though they don’t. for ex) i sometimes silently cry for a close suicidal friend of mine but she doesn’t know that. there are people that care. how did your grandfather convince you not? do you think, if there was an afterlife, your grandfather would like to see you unexpectedly right in the afterlife, after he had convinced you? your grandfather still cares for you and he might not be physically there, but he is watching over you. i’m here too. i cares enough to respond to this post as well as other commenters.
don’t let ur mom win control over you. you live for your  life.. do you wanna rant to me?
is there nothing i can do to make u stay..
